provenance: Extract of Codex's independent BMW reference (read-only task 2026-10-30, bmw-independent-reference.json, computed from the raw wave CSVs, not from the app). Only the moment measures are kept; values copied unchanged.

method.source_scope: Synthetic BMW demonstration, all eligible household vehicle decision makers, independent waves; not actual BMW findings or population inference. No application code, pack validate_pack.py or published reference results read by this calculation.
method.selected: Binary code 1. Code 0 is an answered nonselection; blank is not asked, never recoded as zero for a base. Unknown binary/weight values cause refusal.
method.weights: Raw weight as supplied, finite and strictly positive; unweighted uses unit weights. Kish n_eff=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2) on each stated base.
method.moments: Number of the 12 CEPs linked to brand per respondent. Mean over all eligible; reach=share with >=1 link; mean among linkers; share of links=sum(w*number)/sum over all brands. None/Other and personal relevance flags are outside the twelve brand-specific moment links.
method.recall: Per moment-brand: 100*sum(w*I(link=1 AND aware=1))/sum(w*I(aware=1)). Resolved awareness must include all spontaneous/CEP recalls; asserts no links among unaware, so changing base does not change numerator in this pack.
method.zero_denominator: null with zero base, never substituted zero. Values retained at floating-point full precision.
